title: Sidon autocorrelation constant C_1a, upper bound
statement: C_1a is the largest constant with max_{|t|<=1/2} (f*f)(t) >= C_1a (int f)^2 for every non-negative f. Any non-negative f on [-1/4, 1/4] gives C_1a <= max(f*f) / (int f)^2. Find f making this smaller.
submission: JSON {"values": [...]}: the non-negative heights of a step function with n equal cells on [-1/4, 1/4] (integers, JSON numbers read as binary64, or decimal strings read exactly).

provenance.keeper: T. Tao et al., optimization constants repository (teorth/optimizationproblems)

score: a certified upper bound on the constant (exact; smaller is better)
